name: NalindaDeveloper Audience Subscriptions for Contact Form 7 with Mailchimp
author: Nalinda Prasanna

sections.description:
NalindaDeveloper Audience Subscriptions for Contact Form 7 with Mailchimp connects Contact Form 7 submissions to multiple Mailchimp audiences.

The plugin supports independent Mailchimp settings for each audience, checkbox-based subscription options, subscriber name mapping, and automatic response messages.

This plugin is an independent third-party integration and is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or sponsored by Contact Form 7 or Mailchimp.

Configuration

Configure the email field, first name field, last name field, subscription checkbox field, Mailchimp merge tags, and active Contact Form 7 forms.

For each audience mapping, configure:
* Audience key.
* Display name.
* Mailchimp audience ID.
* Mailchimp API key.
* Mailchimp server prefix.

The value assigned to a Contact Form 7 subscription option must match the configured audience key.

External Services

This plugin connects to the Mailchimp API to add or update contacts in Mailchimp audiences selected through Contact Form 7.

When a visitor submits a configured Contact Form 7 form and selects one or more subscription options, the plugin sends the submitted email address, and when configured, first name and last name, to the corresponding Mailchimp audience. The data is sent only when the form is submitted and a matching audience option is selected.

Mailchimp is a third-party service. This plugin does not send the submitted contact data to Mailchimp unless the corresponding audience option is selected.

sections.installation:
1. Install and activate Contact Form 7.
  2. Upload this plugin through Plugins > Add New Plugin > Upload Plugin.
  3. Activate the plugin.
  4. Configure the Contact Form 7 form fields and audience mappings.
  5. Select the Contact Form 7 forms that should use the integration.
sections.faq:
Can I connect multiple Mailchimp audiences?

Yes. You can configure multiple audience mappings and give each mapping its own Mailchimp API key, server prefix, and audience ID.

Can a user subscribe to more than one audience?

Yes. A Contact Form 7 checkbox field can contain multiple subscription options. Each selected option can be mapped to a different Mailchimp audience.

Does each audience use separate Mailchimp credentials?

Yes. Each configured audience has its own API key, server prefix, and audience ID.

Does the plugin support first and last names?

Yes. You can map Contact Form 7 first-name and last-name fields to Mailchimp merge fields.

Does the plugin require Contact Form 7?

Yes. Contact Form 7 is a required dependency.

1.3.2

  • Added automatic response handling after Contact Form 7 submission.
  • Previous response is cleared when the form is submitted again.
  • Added support for displaying the latest submission response.
  • Maintained independent Mailchimp audience configuration.
  • Updated plugin naming and packaging for WordPress.org review requirements.
